families.subject: JumbledPath capabilities

derivative.title: Researcher-composed companion card referencing JumbledPath
derivative.publisher: Study preparation; not an external publication

families.a: JumbledPath supports capturing network packets from remote devices.
families.a_repeat: The cited account describes remote packet collection by JumbledPath.
families.b: The captured packet data can be compressed and encrypted.
families.notes: Secondary knowledge-base entry; traces both capabilities to Cisco Talos, Salt Typhoon analysis, February 20, 2025. Revision 2 adds fixed attribution context; labels remain author-prepared and require independent review.

context.text: MITRE ATT&CK reports use of JumbledPath by Salt Typhoon.

families.subject: SUNBURST reporting

source.title: Highly evasive attacker leverages SolarWinds supply chain

derivative.title: Researcher-composed companion card referencing Highly evasive attacker leverages SolarWinds supply chain
derivative.publisher: Study preparation; not an external publication

families.a: The SUNBURST backdoor could remain dormant for up to two weeks before retrieving commands.
families.a_repeat: The same account describes an initial dormant period lasting as long as two weeks.
families.b: Its traffic imitated the Orion Improvement Program protocol.
families.notes: Original December 2020 report; updated attribution merges UNC2452 into APT29. MITRE S0559 cites the report. Revision 2 adds fixed attribution context; labels remain author-prepared and require independent review.

context.text: The source update identifies UNC2452 as a cluster subsequently merged into APT29; the report associates SUNBURST with that activity.

families.subject: VB.NET Zebrocy variant

source.title: Dear Joohn: The Sofacy Group's Global Campaign

derivative.title: Researcher-composed companion card referencing Dear Joohn: The Sofacy Group's Global Campaign
derivative.publisher: Study preparation; not an external publication

families.a: The described VB.NET Zebrocy variant collected system information and a list of running processes.
families.a_repeat: The same variant was reported to gather host details and running-process information.

families.notes: Do not generalize this variant-specific observation to every Zebrocy sample. MITRE S0251 cites this report. Revision 2 adds fixed attribution context; labels remain author-prepared and require independent review.
